title: Trust & Control
headline: Every important action leaves a trace.
subhead: Built for owners who demand complete accountability and immutable audit logs.
description: Nothing in Brift is quietly overwritten or deleted. Role-based permissions ensure that each person sees only what their job requires.

steps.title: Money moves after you verify it
steps.text: Purchases, client payments, expense requests, stock transfers and stage completion wait for your verification.

steps.title: Every action has an author
steps.text: The activity log records who did what, when, and from which device.

steps.title: Deleted isn't erased
steps.text: Removing a verified bill posts a reversing entry, so totals and financial history stay consistent.

steps.title: Documents keep their history
steps.text: Drawings and agreements maintain version history; clients can sign or reject documents in their portal.

steps.title: Controlled access
steps.text: Individual logins, email verification, strong passwords, and reviewable, revocable user sessions.
